shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~75 files, ~21,800 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**Where the work is.** §30 cross-level utility networks. Junction/breaker pairs exist for all 15 networks (30 defs, 90 textures); **only the VEF family actually bridges** so far. §2's new ladder and §30a's power clamp are both built and load clean but neither is verified in play.

**The standing risk (unchanged).** §29's depth cut ships ON, judged by eye only. **Any performance report on a mountainous map: throw `MassDepthCutEnabled` first.**

**How to test.** `run_test_cycle`, read TILE/PLAN/bisect BEFORE anything else. Pin `AB2: open all bands` - without it you cannot build on two levels. Companions required or 28 of 30 riser defs stay behind their LoadFolders gate.

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED.
**✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 accepted on look (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean** - four runs (#276-#279), all 126x5. **254 and 190 still never generated.**
**🔧 §25 FIXED, UNVERIFIED** - needs the reporter's save.
**🔧 §30a power gutter clamp BUILT, UNVERIFIED.**
**🔧 §30d VEF merge patch BUILT, UNVERIFIED** - covers 6 of 15 networks.
**🚧 §30c power + Dubwise merge patches NOT BUILT** - 9 of 15 networks have boxes that place and do nothing.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS.** `RegionLink` is read by the region graph and NOTHING else. Every power/pipe system builds its graph from raw CELL ADJACENCY and never consults regions, so edges must be ADDED to each system's own builder (§30).

**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION.** `AB_OpenAir` declares **no affordances**; every building needs `terrainAffordanceNeeded` Light. Combined with every net builder stepping ONE cardinal cell, **no cell-adjacency net can cross a band unaided.**

**Hard 1.6 constraints.** Path grid is IJobParallelFor over EVERY cell. No `PathFinder.FindPath`. `BlocksDiagonalMovement` trips on unwalkable cells.

**⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.**

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, eight shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater jitter | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview (§6d); GL grids (§22); Rimefeller oil (§30e) | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`, no-build edge; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid (§6d) | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature readout, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes (§22) | GL landform output lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter (§30a) | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total | % budget |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 | 77% |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 | 100% |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 | 89% |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP, SO ANCHORING ONE TIER FIXES THE LADDER.** Efficient heights are `slot - 2`: **62, 126, 190, 254, 318, 382**, spaced 64 apart. Nothing efficient lives between them. Keeping 190 *determined* 126 and 254.

**⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN.** Every tier is gutter 2 / gap 3, so gutter behaviour no longer changes with the size pick. Under the old ladder a gutter-crossing bug reproduced at 126/190 and was IMPOSSIBLE at 250 (gap 7) and 300 (gap 21) - the trap §30a walked into.

**⚠ WHAT WAS GIVEN UP.** 250/300 were vanilla Medium/Large exactly - that parity is the real loss. 254 beats 250 outright (97.7% -> 99.2% playable, gutter 6 -> 2). **318 is blocked by arithmetic**: 2 x 101,760 = 203,520, above even the old 192,000, so a second efficient size above 190 cannot exist while the budget falls. **62 is deliberately absent** - 3,844 playable cells and `SeamMarginFor` takes 13% before content; 126 already starved two scatterers. **The wide gutter was real safety and is gone**: at gap 3 every tier is inside a foreign radius helper's reach.

**⚠ THE BUDGET CUT, AND WHAT IT IS NOT BASED ON.** 146,000 = 4 x 190. Down 24% from a figure set by the heaviest tier, one of which (300) was **never generated once**. Evidence: 192,000 exceeded every vanilla map (2.13x Large, 1.20x the 400x400 people are warned off); generation cost tracks BAND size not total cells (#238 5x190/182,400 = 8.3 s vs #236 3x250/192,000 = 12.4 s); the ceiling was only reachable by the two worst tiers. **NOT based on measured framerate** - §10's benchmark measures steady state, not the section-regeneration bursts that cost us.

**⚠ COST SPREAD WAS INVERTED AND NOW IS NOT.** Old: 112,896-192,000 (1.70x) with the SEVEN-level tier cheapest. Now 1.29x, so the size pick is about **shape, not speed**.

**⚠ 200 IS STILL THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - gutter 56, 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe** - `bandHeight` scribed, `SlotFor` generic, `Sizes` never consulted on the load path. 250/300 colonies load fine.
**⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** Read the PLAN line before believing any size test.
**⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.** Chooser writes `GameInitData.mapSize` directly; state released in a `Finalizer`.

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception; hops strictly decrease. **Multi-hop UNTESTED.**
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; NINE appearances of the single-step bug. **`TryResolveVisibleFrom` is THE gate, and it answers TWO questions** (§27). **§29 adds a second, rendering-only descent BESIDE it.**
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER** (§6a). **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS"** and are represented differently. **⚠ MASS FILL IS EMITTED FROM THREE PLACES.** **⚠ THE CAP IS SINGLE-STEP.** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.** **⚠ A `dontRender` VIEWING CELL MEANS OUR FILL IS THE ONLY BACKDROP.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL** (§22). **⚠ 6d-CLAMP: `PlannedSize`, not `Clamp`.** **⚠ MAP PREVIEW SHIPS IN TWO HALVES AND GL BUNDLES ONE.**
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 9. GENERATION COST

## 9a. The profile stamps its own conditions
`TILE`, `PLAN`, `SCOPING:`, two censuses, the bisect state. Has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**

## 9c-9f. Measured cost curve

**OLD LADDER** (plans no longer offered; per-band timings still hold):
| run | plan | tile | gensteps | carve | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #231 | 7x126 | Flat TropSwamp | 3,836 | 1,580 | ~5.7 s |
| #236 | 3x250 | SmallHills | 5,001 | **7,118** | ~12.4 s |
| #237 | 5x190 | Mountainous | 4,529 | 2,201 | ~6.9 s |
| #238 | 5x190 | SmallHills | 3,389 | 4,718 | ~8.3 s |
| #239 | 5x190 | Mtn Desert | 2,217 | 2,357 | ~4.7 s |
| #255 | 5x190 | Mtn Boreal | 2,404 | **1,743** | ~4.1 s |
| #259/#260 | 5x190 | Mtn Boreal +Caves | 3,375/3,488 | 1,937/2,352 | ~5.3/5.8 s |

**NEW LADDER** (146,000 budget):
| run | plan | tile | gensteps | carve | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| #276 | 5x126 | Flat TempForest, rain 1327 | 1,447 | 1,218 | ~2.9 s |
| #277 | 5x126 | LargeHills +Caves +River, rain 2221 | 1,695 | 1,510 | ~3.4 s |
| #278 | 5x126 | Flat ExtremeDesert, rain 158 | 743 | 674 | **~1.6 s** |
| #279 | 5x126 | LargeHills TempForest, rain 762 | 1,627 | 975 | ~2.8 s |

**⚠ THE NEW LADDER'S WHOLE RANGE (1.6-3.4 s) SITS BELOW THE OLD LADDER'S BEST (4.1 s).** But all four are 126, the cheap tier. **254 has NEVER been generated and should be the slowest offered tier.**

**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size:** 190 -> 36,480 cells -> ~960-2,385 ms; 250 -> 64,000 -> 4,254 ms. **1.75x cells, 2.87x time.** This killed the 250 tier.
**⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`:** 25.3 ms at rain 158 (#278) vs 543 ms at rain 1327 (#276) - a **21x spread on the same plan**. Confirms §9g's demotion: optimising it wins nothing on a desert.
**⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED TO A RANGE.** §9 previously recorded "Caves costs ~1.1-1.2 s in `MutatorPostElevationFertility`, the largest genstep on those maps" from n=2 (#259/#260, both 5x190 Mtn Boreal). **#277 HAS Caves and that genstep took 49.6 ms** - the *without-Caves* figure - with the cost appearing in `MutatorPostTerrain` (382 ms) instead. Band size does not explain it. **n=2 was not a pattern, again. Report the range, stop naming drivers.**
**⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING TEST IS VALID AT ALL.** A Flat tile spawns no mass wide enough for mask-15 interiors; a warm tile seeds no snow; **a one-stone map cannot express a queue-ordering bug** (§29). #277 and #279 suppressed THREE stone types each - those tiles can.

## 9g. ⚠ RE-RANKED ON EVIDENCE
1. **Basement rock suppression** - ~1.0-4.3 s, tile-independent. **Item 1.**
2. `GenStep_Plants` scoping - 0.03-2.3 s, rainfall-driven. **Demoted.**
3. `GenStep_RockChunks` - `Filth_RubbleRock` is top-destroyed on EVERY tile without exception.
4. Scattered ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in section-regeneration BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS, AND THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.** Run #172 opened with a stale `belowWater=False` that mimicked a fixed bug exactly; **#277 opened with the same stale flag on a map that had a River.** Caught by the stamp both times. A toggle that can silently invalidate a measurement must announce itself inside that measurement.
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=14.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR PROFILE AND BISECT LINES ARRIVE AS `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US** - a run reporting only those is CLEAN.
**⚠ THE AUTO-PROMPT IS EDGE-TRIGGERED - CHECK THE COUNT, NOT THE TEXT.**
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.** Rimefeller ships a malformed `Textures/Rimefeller/UI/discord.dds` that fails `ModDdsLoader.TryLoadDds` every run. **Any** bad texture hashes identically, so re-verify the `absFilePath` after changing art - **unless the build is byte-identical**, in which case re-drilling is waste.
**⚠ Debug actions are `AllowedGameStates.PlayingOnMap`.** **⚠ AUDIT A DIAGNOSTIC'S OWN FILTERS BEFORE TRUSTING A NEGATIVE.**
**⚠ A GUARD SWITCH WITH NO CALL SITE IS NOISE** - add one in the same commit as its guard.

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **VERIFY §30d in play** - chemfuel junction + breaker in the same cell one level apart; do the nets merge, does the flick split them.
2. **BUILD §30c** - vanilla power flood fill, then the three Dubwise `RebuildPipeGrid` merges. 9 of 15 networks.
3. **GENERATE AT 254** - never once, expected slowest. And at 190.
4. **VERIFY §30a** at any tier (all gap 3 now).
5. **VERIFY §25 on the reporter's save.**
6. **Basement rock suppression** (§9g item 1).
7. Regenerate the power junction art - north/south were swapped for the wall convention, and north's box is 65% off south's aspect.
8. §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; depth shrink; camera anchor; preview at 254.
9. **Never exercised:** multi-hop stair router, elevator, basement PATHING, cavern basement.
10. **§22 TABLED.** 11. **CAI 5000** (§26). 12. **§30g** VTE's `RoofGrid_SetRoof_Patch` vs `ABSkySync`.

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. Run the diagnostic before the third theory. A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠ ASSERTING AN INVARIANT IS NOT ESTABLISHING IT.** Carry the ANSWER, not the assumption.
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.** **⚠ READ THE GUARD CLAUSES OF THE HELPER YOU ARE ABOUT TO REUSE.** **⚠ ASK HOW THE SUBSYSTEM REPRESENTS THE THING, NOT WHAT THE THING IS.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE** - and **the TIER is part of that configuration**.
**⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.** Band height looks continuous; Slot is 64-aligned, so there is ONE efficient height per step. **Enumerate what the quantisation permits before offering a "range".**
**⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER** - and 300 had never been generated once. **Check which option SETS a limit and whether it has ever been exercised.**
**⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS AND STILL LOOK CORRECT.** The cell budget models pathfinding and says nothing about generation, which is superlinear in BAND size. **Name which cost a gate models, then check it is the one users feel.**
**⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS LIKE THE MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.**
**⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4** - the Caves claim died at n=3 (see §9). **Report the RANGE and stop naming drivers.** This rule has now been broken and re-learned twice on the same table.
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS - COUNT THE CODEBASES.** Six mods, two patch families. **The mod list is a marketing artifact, not an architecture.**
**⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ GATE AGAINST THE HOST MOD'S OWN UNLOCK, `MayRequire` INCLUDED.** **⚠ A MOD CAN HAVE A RESEARCH SYSTEM THAT IS NOT `ResearchProjectDef`.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.**
**⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG - DO NOT COPY THEM BLIND.** Luciferium files its pipes under `VCHE_PipeNetworks`, a category defined by Chemfuel Expanded, which it does not depend on. Our Luciferium risers use vanilla `Misc` instead.
**⚠ TWO CALL SITES OF ONE CONSTANT CAN NEED TWO DIFFERENT FIXES** (§30a). Filtering an enumeration is lossless when its caller takes everything; filtering a nearest-wins SEARCH is not.
**⚠ A LOSSY NORMALISER IS NOT A WAY TO READ A CHOICE.** **⚠ A CONSTRAINT SATISFIED BY EVERY EXAMPLE IS NOT NECESSARILY THE CONSTRAINT.** **⚠ A RULE ENFORCED BY GREPPING A SYNTAX ONLY CATCHES THAT SYNTAX.** **⚠ A DESIGN CHOICE RECORDED WITHOUT ITS COST WILL BE READ AS FREE.** **⚠ THE REAL CONFLICT IS USUALLY A REPLACEMENT, NOT A COLLISION.** **⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT BEFORE BUILDING IT.** **⚠ A SHARED METHOD NAME IS A HYPOTHESIS, NOT A CONFLICT.**
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ Duplication is how an invariant dies.** **⚠ A comment is not an invariant.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.**
**Patching.** Re-aim the shared parameter. Find the ONE virtual everything funnels through - and when there is none, **wrap the DATA instead of the reader**. Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. **Never put a foreign type in a patch signature** - resolve by name in `Prepare`, type `__instance` as `object`. **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Read the LIVE def field, never a baked copy.** **Prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo".**
**Engine facts.** `holdSnowOrSand` defaults TRUE; `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on a `holdSnowOrSand=false` terrain OR a Full-fillage edifice. `SectionLayer_Snow` rewrites only COLOURS. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE.** A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during map generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread - generation latches must be `[ThreadStatic]`. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED (~40x cheaper).** Harmony skips POSTFIXES when the original throws but always runs FINALIZERS. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** `ThingDef.graphic` is baked at PostLoad; `graphicData.Graphic` is lazily rebuilt. **Vanilla rock links with `MapEdge`, so off-map counts as LINKED.** `Building.SpawnSetup` registers with the edifice grid unconditionally. **`Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back to `_east` with `westFlipped` when `_west` is absent, so a rotatable building needs only north/east/south.**
**⚠⚠ A WALL ATTACHMENT'S ROTATION IS THE DIRECTION OF THE WALL, NOT THE WAY IT FACES.** `Placeworker_AttachedToWall` and `GenConstruct.GetWallAttachedTo` both demand a Full-fillage `supportsWallAttachments` building at `loc + GenAdj.CardinalDirections[rot.AsInt]`; `CardinalDirections[0]` is `(0,0,1)` = north = up the screen; `Rot4.North.AsInt` is 0; `Graphic_Multi` takes `mats[0]` as `_north`. **Therefore `_north` is the view with the wall ABOVE and the front face visible - the hero view - which is the REVERSE of the usual habit where `_south` faces the player.** Nothing in the art can tell you this is wrong: swapped files just look like a unit that turns its back when rotated. Vanilla's `WallLamp`/`TorchWallLamp` are the reference defs (`isAttachment` + `Placeworker_AttachedToWall` + Standable + BuildingOnTop + non-edifice). **`CompPower` resolves an attachment's connector position from the WALL it hangs on** (`CompPower.cs:199`), so wall-mounted power works unaided.
**⚠ POWER/PIPE ENGINE FACTS.** `PowerNetMaker.ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE; flood fill over `GenAdj.CellsAdjacentCardinal`. **`PowerConnectionMaker.ConnectMaxDist = 6`**, used by both search methods, with NO line-of-sight, room or region check. **`RegionLink` is invisible to every power and pipe system.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION.** **A plain HarmonyPatch on a C# iterator targets the STUB, so `__result` is the whole `IEnumerable` - but the wrapper body runs LAZILY, outside your try/catch.**
**⚠ TEXTURE FACTS.** **RimWorld's Core textures are PACKED** - `Data/Core` has no Textures folder, so read MOD PNGs instead and treat VE art as the vanilla proxy. **There are TWO art families and they are near-opposites**: Dubwise (DBH/Rimefeller/Rimatomics) is one faceplate sprite recoloured per network with a **thick near-black outline**, plate colour as identity; Vanilla/VE is **almost no outline**, flat colour blocks butted together, tiny accents. Prompting both with one style block is why three attempts failed. **Describe the SPRITE, not the object** - a rich physical description drives an image model straight to a 3D render. **Attaching a real sprite beats any amount of adjectives.**

# 30. CROSS-LEVEL UTILITY NETWORKS

## 30-DESIGN. JUNCTION + BREAKER, MERGE MODEL
The user's design, and it is better than the symmetric riser it replaced.
- **Junction box** - the machinery. Bridges to a breaker one level UP *and* one DOWN, so one junction serves three levels. 60 steel + 2 components, 1600 work.
- **Breaker box** - the cheap receiving end, carrying the switch. 25 steel + 1 component, 900 work.
- Both **wall-mounted attachments**; the pair must occupy the **same cell** on adjacent bands.

**⚠ THE SPLIT IS PRESENTATIONAL AND TOPOLOGICAL, NOT A FLOW DIRECTION.** Once paired, the two networks MERGE and resources pool exactly as on one level. **RimWorld's `PowerNet` has no one-way edge and neither does any foreign pipe system** - a genuinely directional link would mean two nets plus a transfer system with its own battery, priority and overflow rules. What the split buys is legibility: which level owns the machinery, and one obvious home for the switch.

**⚠ THE SWITCH IS `CompFlickable` FOR EVERY FAMILY, WHICH WAS NOT OBVIOUS.** "Flick switch for power, close-valve for pipes" collapses to one comp: VEF's `CompPipeValve.TransmitResourceNow => compFlickable.SwitchIsOn`, DBH's `Building_Valve` uses `CompFlickable` + `FlickUtility.WantsToBeOn`, vanilla's power switch is `CompPowerTransmitter` + `CompFlickable`. **VEF breakers use `CompProperties_PipeValve` because its `ReceiveCompSignal` already un/registers the connector on FlickedOff/FlickedOn - the rebuild comes free.** Dubwise and power breakers use the host's normal comp plus `CompProperties_Flickable` and **still need an explicit rebuild poke**, which lands with their merge patches.

**⚠ AUTO-SPAWNING THE TWIN IS NOT AVAILABLE.** Stairs do it, but a wall attachment cannot: the matching cell one level up frequently has no wall, so the twin would fail to place or be placed illegally.

## 30-CORE. `ABRiserLink.AppendPartners` IS THE ONE ANSWER
Every family's merge patch funnels through it. **Symmetric by construction** - a junction looks for breakers, a breaker looks for junctions - so whichever end a rebuild starts from finds the other, and no patch needs to know which side it stands on.
**⚠ THE PARTNER CELL IS `(x, z ± Slot)`, NOT `± bandHeight`.** Stepping by height skews the offset by a growing multiple of the gutter - the single-step descent slip for the tenth time.
`ABRiserExt` carries `network` (**our** identifier, since Dubwise names networks with an enum member, VEF with a `PipeNetDef` and vanilla power not at all) and `role`.

## 30a. 🔧 BUILT, UNVERIFIED: VANILLA POWER LEAKED ACROSS THE GUTTER
`ConnectMaxDist = 6` via `ExpandedBy(6)` in both `BestTransmitterForConnector` and `PotentialConnectorsForTransmitter`, no line-of-sight or region test. Band gap is 3, so an appliance near a band edge drew power through solid rock.
**⚠ THE RADIUS LEAKED; THE FLOOD FILL DID NOT** - one cardinal step, and the gutter is unbuildable.
**Fix (`ABPowerBandScope.cs`).** The iterator's `__result` is **wrapped and filtered** (lossless - its caller attaches every candidate). The nearest-transmitter search is **detect, then redo**. **⚠ NULLING A CROSS-BAND ANSWER WOULD BE WRONG** - vanilla picks the NEAREST, so it can beat a legal in-band conduit a cell further away.

## 30d. ✅ BUILT: VEF PIPESYSTEM - ONE POSTFIX, SIX NETWORKS
`PipeNetManager.NeighbourThingsCardinal` is the **single funnel**: `RegisterConnector`, `UnregisterConnector` and `CreatePipeNetFrom` all call it, so one postfix covers net creation, merge-on-build and split-on-deconstruct. Covers Chemfuel, Deepchem, VentDuct and the three Luciferium nets, plus any future VE pipe mod.
**⚠ NOT ONE FOREIGN TYPE IN THE FILE** - resolved by name in `Prepare`, postfix deals only in `Thing`/`List<Thing>`. **⚠ The parameter MUST be named `thing`** - Harmony binds by name.

## 30c. NOT BUILT: POWER + DUBWISE
Vanilla power needs the `PowerNetMaker` flood fill to hop pairs. The three Dubwise mods ship the SAME `RebuildPipeGrid(int P)`; **`PassCheck` is a local-function closure and cannot be patched**, so the hook is a POSTFIX that merges nets. **⚠ THE AUTHOR ALREADY PUBLISHED THE RECIPE** - `HygienePipeMapComp.RefreshInternetsOnTile` merges nets across maps on one tile. Follow it.

## 30e. RIMEFELLER OIL IS A SLICING-RULE BUG
`RegenSeedGrids()` runs Perlin over `map.AllCells` on absolute coordinates, smearing one field up the stack - oil pockets in SKY bands. **`BandLocalModule` is the drop-in fix.**
